description: This file is an HTML document that includes embedded CSS and JavaScript code, serving as a front-end interface for visualizing database contents. It provides UI elements, event handlers, and functions to load and display databases, tables, and data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets state, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show or hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for table data display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
